content:
jamal: Quick kickoff — integrator roundtable with Vertex Labs on May 12. Need to finalize speakers, demo kit ops, and a local swag pickup plan. Can the core team confirm availability?
maria: I'm in. I can own speaker outreach and bios. Deadline: EOD Tue for final bios.
alex: Marketing will need speaker headshots + 1-paragraph blurbs by Wed. Also want to confirm webinar landing page CTA.
leo: I'll handle demo kit checklist and on-site handoff. Shipping ETA to venue is May 10. Who's the on-site Vertex contact?
sarah: @leo vertex contact is Priya K. 415-555-0198. She's confirmed a locker at the venue for kit & swag. Locker ID: A-12. Code arrives day-of from venue ops.
jamal: Perfect. Two big ops asks: 1) a robust fallback if live demo fails, 2) a simple local swag pickup flow so attendees can grab stickers/handouts without queuing vendor booths.
maria: Fallback idea: short recorded demo plus live QA. We should prepare a 2-min video upload to S3 and have a slide deck with annotated timestamps.
leo: Agree. I'll also prepare a tiny local demo that runs on laptop (no GPU) that we can switch to if the GPU rack has issues.
ops-bot: calendar: Event created — "Integrator Roundtable w/ Vertex Labs" May 12 14:00-15:00 PT. Join link added to thread.
alex: For swag pickup: proposal — attendees get an SMS QR code after registering; QR redeems at locker A-12; onsite volunteer scans and opens locker. Volunteers: @leo (lead), @maria (backup). Thoughts?
sarah: Love it. Add one more backup volunteer from Vertex — Priya said she'll make someone available. Also need to confirm locker size.
leo: Locker size 24"x18"x12" — can fit 120 sticker packs + 30 demo dongles. I'll inventory and send manifest by Friday.
jamal: Manifest should include item counts and weight for the courier. Also include a labelled contact on each boxed kit.
leo: Will do. Draft manifest: 
```
- 120 sticker packs
- 30 USB-C demo dongles (preloaded image)
- 10 backup Raspberry Pi demo kits
- 150 one-sheet product cards
```
I'll attach weights and dimensions in the final.
maria: Speaker run-of-show checklist: slides due May 5, dry run May 10 10:00 PT, final slide deck exported as PDF and uploaded to shared drive. Please confirm.
alex: Marketing will push promo on May 1 and reminders May 8 + May 11. Need speaker approval for PR blurbs before May 3.
sarah: AV needs: 1x HDMI input (for laptop), 1x backup dongle, wired ethernet for demo laptop, mic lav for moderator. Venue AV rep: Carlos — carlos@venueops.com.
leo: I'll bring 2x HDMI adapters + 5m HDMI cable + USB-C charger + local static IP prepared. Also a small Ethernet switch.
jamal: Demo routing: primary -> Vertex private rack; fallback -> local laptop with preloaded scenario; final fallback -> 2-min video + slides. Make sure we have the video link handy in the panelist notes.
ops-bot: reminder: Dry run scheduled May 10 10:00 PT. Auto invite sent to participants.
maria: PR note — please avoid mentioning exact latency/cost numbers in talk. Use qualitative phrasing unless legal signs off.
alex: Noted. Also confirm swag pickup hours (we should keep locker staffed 30 mins before and 45 mins after the session).
sarah: Agree. Volunteer shifts: 13:30-14:30 @leo, 14:30-15:30 @maria, Vertex covers 15:30-16:00.
leo: I'll deliver the manifest and a photo of the packed locker tonight.
jamal: Final items: 1) capture short speaker bios + headshots by Wed, 2) demo manifest Friday, 3) slides May 5, 4) dry run May 10. I'll follow up with a checklist DM to each owner. Thanks all :raised_hands:.
